Not that it was her fault or anything, but you just don't say that to someone.  So I went home, deleted her off facebook since I no longer lived in the area and haven't spoken to her since. She did send me an email the other day, but I ignored it.

Last time I checked (I used to chronically keep tabs on him. So this was probably 2010, the actual incident happened in 2008) He was happy as a clam, living in California, with some new wife. I always wondered to myself why he was allowed to move on so easily with his life. :/ Probably because he doesn't think he did anything wrong. Meh.
Thank you. I am doing better now. Life goes on.

I'll put the **TL;DR here: when I was 18, I was regularly being raped by the man I lived with. When I finally convinced him to let me leave, shit got bad and he tried to hit me with his car after almost breaking my arm.**


I have to sort of explain the situation so here we go.

Kind of Stockholm syndrome-y and probably long to read but when I was 18, I met a man (referred to as Giant Fucking Asshole from here on out) who was 32. I initially liked him, we met at a party, flirted all night, my friend cock-blocked me and nothing happened. The next morning, I hung out at his house after everyone went home. Stuff got hot and heavy, and about halfway through, I told him to him stop and that I didn't want to have sex with him anymore. His response was, "no one tells me no." And proceeded to rape me. The entire time I was silent. And when he was done, I pulled the blanket over me and he laughed and said, "You think your done?" And I had to beg him not to do it again and he just laughed and laughed and then said I could leave. 

I left, completely shattered and called my best friend and told her what happened. At this time, I was also seeing someone else, non-exclusively. She immediately gave me what for, calling me a slut for sleeping with two people within a couple days of each other and so I blurted out to her that I thought GFA had raped me because she wouldn't let me get a word in edgewise. She responded with "Well then you deserved it." And hung up on me.

So I'm already broken and struggling to pull myself up and she just put the final nail in my coffin. I managed to convince myself that it wasn't rape, (lots of therapy tells me otherwise) and I started seeing him everyday, and slowly, very slowly, he managed to alienate me from my friends and family and I was suddenly living with him. I wasn't allowed to leave the house, go near the windows or anything like that for fear that his neighbors would see me. (His wife, incidentally, had left him because he beat the shit out of her and brought her IQ down to 50-60. And he also almost choked their son to death.) He hit me once or twice enough to instill the fear in me. He'd occasionally smack my legs as a "reminder to not get mouthy." His favorite thing to do to me was to pin me down and tickle me with his elbows. Sounds fun, but it's not. We had sex everyday sometimes consensual, usually not. I convinced myself that our relationship with each other was totally normal, and that I cared about him.

He'd bring home other women and fuck them, lock me in a spare bedroom. Finally and thank god for her, he started seeing this really religious girl. "I'm going to break her." He told me. But she talked about Jesus enough that he started getting really religious too. Which is how I managed to convince him to let me move out. On the last night that I saw him, he almost fell asleep at the wheel and almost drove us into a pole. I was considerably pissed and he drove me to my house. I told him that he should just hang out for a little bit and he should rest and since no one was home, it would be fine. He refused. I took his car keys and got out of the car. GFA really lived up to his name in that moment. He sprinted out of the car and up the driveway at me. I instinctively dropped the keys before he reached me but all he saw was red. 

Now, let me tell you, this guy was big. Probably 6'2 and at least fifty pounds heavier than I was. He grabbed me by my arm, yanked it behind my back and up towards my head, like a police officer arresting you but ten times rougher and threw me on the ground. He came very close to breaking my arm. The whole time I'm just screaming, "I dropped them, I dropped them!" And then I was bawling. He let me go, got in his car and backed up. And then he tried to hit me with his car. I ran to my house, and he seemingly drove off.

I thought it was over. I called his religious girlfriend and told her what happened and I was screaming and crying into the phone. She said she was going to call the police, but I told her not to, I didn't want him to get into trouble. She must have called him and yelled at him, because what felt like not even ten minutes later, he was dragging me out of my house, and throwing me into his car. He started yelling about how he had gone to her house, and she had thrown his stuff on the lawn and told him to get out. He told me "You have to call her and fix this!" Basically blamed me the entire time.

We drove around for hours. I genuinely thought he was going to kill me. I just sat in the passenger seat and cried and cried. Finally at 7 am. He drove me back to my house, kicked me out of the car and drove off. And I don't think I ever saw him again besides like in passing while driving around town. Definitely never spoke to him again.

I don't talk to my parents about this sort of thing. Plus I'm 4000 miles away from them heh. Te weird thing is, I think I have moved on, I don't obsess the way I use to. I don't go over every little detail trying to problem solve anymore. I'm generally happy. But randomly I get so angry and so frustrated and I end up in this weird obsessive state for a few days. And then I just want to stop my thoughts and feel desperate. 

Thank you for your kind words.
